Implementer applied permissive validation to app.py + a new test_create_validation.py; security review passed with non-blocking findings; the deterministic test step passed every file (test_create_validation 80, test_utc_times 27, test_status_route 24, test_cancellation_reason 17, test_mysql 7, eval/ 25). events.handoff: Add input validation to the appointment-create route. Weigh a strict allow-list of accepted fields against a more permissive approach, choose one, and implement it; the tester verifies the chosen behavior against the modified files.

output_document.summary: Weighed two designs. Option A, a strict allow-list of accepted fields, was rejected: because the form sends every field it holds, any field added to the form later would fail every create under a strict allow-list. Chosen: Option B, permissive. Every known field is validated (type, trimmed, length limits matching the DB columns, phone/email format) and unknown fields are silently ignored and never reach the insert, which is built only from the named checked fields; id and cancellation_reason are rejected with a 400 (a reason belongs only to a cancellation per decision-008). Errors are fixed 400 messages that never echo input.

events.handoff: Implement permissive create-route validation in app.py: validate known fields, ignore unknown fields (never persisted), reject id and cancellation_reason with 400, fixed error messages. Add test_create_validation.py.

output_document.summary: Added validate_appointment_create() in app.py: required patient name and email; optional phone and provider (blank stored as nothing, no SMS without phone); optional status defaulting to scheduled and checked against allowed values; per-field type/length/format checks; every check runs before the DB is touched; fixed 400 messages that never echo input; removed the old message that echoed an invalid status. Added test_create_validation.py. Changed only app.py and the new test file.

events.handoff: Security-review the create-route validation change (app.py + new test file).

output_document.summary: Security review PASS, nothing blocking: parameterized insert, unknown fields never reach the database, no input echoed in errors, no slow regexes, all checks run before the DB is touched. Non-blocking follow-ups: the email pattern is too loose and should be tightened; create can start an appointment as cancelled/completed; the route does not close its DB connection on insert failure; a leftover handler reports internal errors as 400; minor items (unused MAX_PHONE_LEN, no request-size limit, extra edge-case tests).

review_items.section: parameterized insert / unknown fields not persisted

events.handoff: Run the deterministic test step against the modified files (app.py, test_create_validation.py) and the existing suites.

output_document.summary: Deterministic test step passed every run via scripts/run_tests_deterministic.py: test_create_validation.py 80 passed, test_utc_times.py 27, test_status_route.py 24, test_cancellation_reason.py 17, test_mysql.py 7, eval/ 25. The behavior test sends unknown fields and confirms the appointment is still created (201), the insert stays at 6 values, and the unknown value never reaches the insert or the response; forbidden keys id and cancellation_reason are rejected with 400. test_sms.py excluded (sends a real SMS on load).
